detail: remote worker永遠不得讀寫worktree registry、gate record、local main、integration state、cutover、sync或deploy；唯一有權寫gate record的仍是Oscar呼叫端worktree內、與當下HEAD匹配的worktree_orchestrate.py。adapter只路由profile registry明示remote_eligible且不需Xcode／Simulator／Git metadata／production state的child gate；其餘保持local，絕不把gate plan的任意cmd轉送Felix。遠端receipt必須由本機以pinned Felix public key驗canonical signature，並精確核對Oscar產生的CSPRNG nonce、canonical request digest、one-time job id、host=felix、source commit/tree、profile/spec/runner image、rc/status、timestamps/freshness、log/artifact digest與admission snapshot；job id以O_EXCL建立並在驗後標consumed，防止重播。任一缺欄、錯配、過期、簽章錯誤、receipt重播、log被改、worker中斷或結果無法歸因即視為未執行，不得合成pass。驗證完成到寫record前若HEAD移動，整份結果丟棄。adapter只把validated child的既有status/summary交回原_run_gate聚合路徑，不新增verdict狀態、不改pass/warn/block/inconclusive或cutover freshness。進度與耗時分別消費IMP-20260808-043e16、IMP-20260808-4bd1ef，禁止第二份sidecar/history。第一階段opt-in；只有child尚未開始的transport/admission failure可具名local fallback。
